2608.05863.title: Runtime Observability for Heterogeneous Attention Memory
2608.05863.paper_summary: Modern models no longer keep a plain KV cache: latent caches, learned sparse selectors and recurrent states each carry the model's memory in a different form, and each fails differently under compression. We give a runtime observability contract that covers all four memory classes with three operators, instantiate it on six model configurations across five architecture families, and compose the per-stage bounds into an executable request-level risk ledger. Contracts carry their error metric as a type -- composition is only defined when metrics match, and this check rejected our own first composed chain; the repaired chain crosses metrics through two proved bridges, and whatever no formal system can certify is measured instead, dropping the composed tier to empirical automatically: every claim is certified, partially certified, or empirical, composition inherits the weakest tier, and the tier is decided by the machine. Replayed over $12.4$M entry reads and run under eight-way concurrency with per-request budgets and fail-closed identity attribution, the ledger quantifies the honest trade-off on today's witness and holds its risk budget with zero violations. A fused always-on probe observes a declared one-layer subset under CUDA graphs inside the serving noise floor. Applied to a served DeepSeek-V4 stack with a packed compressed-KV prototype, the same machinery localizes a silent corruption to a precise structural boundary -- exact in the eviction-free, identity-isolated regime, with every observed failure in an eviction or slot-reuse regime -- through a machine-adjudicated discrimination campaign whose calculus rejected two of our own confounded inferences along the way. All artifacts, guards, and the Lean development are released at https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory; every number in this paper regenerates from the shipped artifacts by one command.
2608.05863.paper_summary_zh: 現代模型不再僅僅保持一個簡單的KV緩存：潛在緩存、學習的稀疏選擇器和遞歸狀態各自以不同的形式承載模型的記憶，並且在壓縮下各自的失敗方式也不同。我們提供了一個運行時可觀察性契約，涵蓋所有四種記憶類別，並使用三個運算子，在五個架構系列的六個模型配置上實例化它，並將每個階段的界限組合成可執行的請求級風險賬本。契約攜帶其錯誤度量作為一種類型——當度量匹配時，組合才被定義，而這一檢查拒絕了我們自己第一個組合鏈；修復後的鏈通過兩個已證明的橋樑跨越度量，而任何沒有正式系統可以認證的東西則被測量，從而自動將組合層級降至經驗層級：每個聲明都是經過認證的、部分認證的或經驗的，組合繼承最弱的層級，層級由機器決定。在超過$12.4$M的條目讀取上重播，並在八路並發下運行，具有每請求預算和失敗關閉身份歸屬，賬本量化了今天見證的誠實權衡，並以零違規維持其風險預算。一個融合的始終開啟的探針在服務噪聲底層下觀察一個聲明的單層子集，該子集位於CUDA圖內。應用於一個提供的DeepSeek-V4堆疊，配合一個打包的壓縮-KV原型，相同的機制將一個靜默的損壞定位到一個精確的結構邊界——在無驅逐、身份隔離的範疇內是精確的，並且每個觀察到的失敗都發生在驅逐或插槽重用的範疇內——通過一個機器裁決的歧視運動，其計算拒絕了我們自己沿途的兩個混淆推論。所有的工件、保護措施和精簡開發都在 https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory 發布；本文中的每個數字都可以通過一個命令從發送的工件中重新生成。
